scope: CVG-004 bounded tenant-scoped scheduled financial-advance-payments report resolution through the real worker

criteria.description: The persisted advance-payment report source is shared through the financial module boundary, remains compatible with the API repository surface and is composed by the worker without an app-to-app dependency.
criteria.limitations: The source proof uses disposable local PostgreSQL; target deployment and runtime-role topology remain outside this gate.

criteria.description: The worker validates strict status/search/date filters before querying, applies an inclusive dateTo, rejects more than 10,000 rows and maps exactly the ten financial-advance-payments catalog columns.
criteria.limitations: Wildcard escaping and session-timezone semantics remain adjacent hardening items; the bounded contract follows the existing API source semantics.

criteria.description: Worker bootstrap checks the required advance-payment tables, source columns, FORCE RLS, tenant predicates and immutable/over-allocation triggers, composes the source only when ready and fails closed in production-like environments.
criteria.limitations: The readiness probe does not fully assert every ACL, function and deployed runtime-role property, and no explicit incomplete-schema bootstrap fixture was added.

criteria.description: A fresh due schedule executes in a real one-shot worker against disposable PostgreSQL with two accounts, exact allocation-derived output, inclusive date-boundary coverage and negative status/search/date/tenant fixtures.
criteria.limitations: Disposable PostgreSQL and a NOBYPASSRLS local connection do not certify the target TCP endpoint, deployed grants or production execution.

criteria.description: The intentional RED is retained and the corrected worker/module/API, coverage, typecheck, security, static contracts, formatting and diff-hygiene rails pass.
criteria.limitations: Coverage follows the repository's designated exclusions; remote CI, browser/accessibility, operations and release acceptance remain outside this gate.

criteria.description: An independent post-implementation read-only review inspected the bounded implementation and returned a conditional bounded result without a Critical finding; its residuals remain explicit.
criteria.limitations: Hubble's review is conditional rather than unconditional approval; actor fallback, audit semantics, duplicate API projection, bootstrap completeness and edge-test gaps remain bounded follow-up items.

criteria.description: The scheduled advance-payment result is reconciled without promoting CVG-004, strict Vetus parity, clinical parity, enterprise readiness or release acceptance.
criteria.limitations: General parity remains 98/100 with 4/11 verified, clinical parity 100/100 with 2/3 verified, and enterprise readiness 95/100 with 42 PASS / 3 WARN / 1 FAIL.

gaps: The independent review is conditional, so this gate is not unconditional post-fix approval.
Worker actor fallback, scheduled audit semantics, duplicate API read projection and complete bootstrap ACL/function/runtime-role assertions remain adjacent residuals.
Disposable local PostgreSQL does not certify target TCP/RLS/FORCE-RLS, deployed roles, providers, distributed operations or release behavior.
Other scheduled report families, global parity, clinical parity, enterprise readiness, accessibility, remote CI and backup/restore remain open.
